_doc: Signals for the asset-source vs amount-origin consistency lens. Two-signal, FP-tight: flags a function that references >=2 distinct asset-source FAMILIES and transfers/accounts using a source different from where the amount was derived. Derived from Recall H-05 (leave transfers genesisBalance — a supply amount — out of collateralSource) and DT-002.

source_family_mismatch.description: Amount derived from one asset-source family but transferred/accounted from another (e.g. genesisBalance/supply paid out of collateralSource).

value_kind_exclusion.description: A value-bearing cross-message excludes or double-counts one call kind in the supply/accounting decrement.
